name: trustmesh-open-agentic-web
description: TrustMesh: consent-carrying service handoffs for the Open Agentic Web

scripts.predev: npm run sync:runtime && npm run networks:build
scripts.predev:partner: npm run sync:runtime && npm run networks:build
scripts.pages:build:trustmesh: npm run sync:runtime && npm run networks:build && npm run build:trustmesh
scripts.pages:build:partner: npm run sync:runtime && npm run networks:build && npm run build:partner
